page_title: EVE 0-3 MNU | Everton v Manchester Utd 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

90+5' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Jack Harrison (Everton) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. The strike heads towards the left post, but it's deflected away thanks to a wonderful intervention by one of the defenders.
90+4' The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+2' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Chermiti (Everton) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure walks off the pitch and Lewis Dobbin (Everton) comes on as a substitute.

89' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
89' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
88' James Garner (Everton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

85' Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jordan Pickford pulls off an easy save.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch so that Anthony Martial can be given a rest.
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Manchester Utd was in an offside position.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
83' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) jumps into a tackle and John Brooks signals a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
82' Here comes a substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin is given a rest as he is replaced by Chermiti (Everton).
81' James Garner (Everton) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
80' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
78' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
76' Mitchell van der Gaag decides to make a substitution. Luke Shaw will be replaced by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United).
75' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Bruno Fernandes tees up Anthony Martial (Manchester United) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Jordan Pickford.
73' A substitution has been made. Dwight McNeil is replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
73' That will be all from Ashley Young who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nathan Patterson (Everton).
72' Here is a change. Kobbie Mainoo is going off and Mitchell van der Gaag gives the last tactical orders to Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch for Alejandro Garnacho.

71' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
70' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared.
70' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Everton have a corner.
69' Everton fail to score from a corner as Andre Onana (Manchester United) leaps to collect the ball.

68' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
66' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
65' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
65' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
64' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
62' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
61' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Vitali Mykolenko (Everton), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
60' James Tarkowski (Everton) sends a long ball forward to Jack Harrison, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
58' James Garner (Everton) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

56' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top right corner. Andre Onana is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
56' 0 - 2 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jordan Pickford into the top left corner.
56' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
55' The Manchester Utd players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
55' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in referee John Brooks deciding not to issue any card.

54' Play continues despite the shouts by some Manchester Utd players for a penalty. Wait! Referee John Brooks interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
51' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Bruno Fernandes lays the ball off to Scott McTominay (Manchester United), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Manchester Utd are ruled offside.

43' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. John Brooks blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Manchester Utd have a free kick.

41' Andre Onana doesn't have to worry about this one. Abdoulaye Doucoure plays a pass into the feet of Idrissa Gueye (Everton), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
41' Ashley Young swings the cross over. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
38' A pass into the penalty area from Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence.
35' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

34' Dwight McNeil (Everton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
33' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post.

32' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana easily deals with the threat. Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Andre Onana, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
31' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
31' The referee awards a corner and James Garner (Everton) goes over to take it.

30' Jack Harrison (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' The referee shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
28' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

25' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball miles wide of the left post. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Everton, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
24' 1:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 1:1.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Ashley Young (Everton) for his blatant foul.
20' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
17' Ashley Young (Everton) brings an opponent down and John Brooks interrupts the game. Free kick. Manchester Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
13' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jordan Pickford scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.
13' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Manchester Utd get a corner.
11' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

10' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Andre Onana makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
8' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
6' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) threads a pass through to Alejandro Garnacho, but Jordan Pickford breaks up the move.
6' A spell of possession for Manchester Utd in an attempt to control the game.
3' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Diogo Dalot sends a brilliant cross into the box and Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 0:1.
2' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
John Brooks was nominated as the referee for this game.
